message.content:
I don’t have real‑time access to current air‑quality data. To find out the present conditions in Los Angeles, you can check one of the following resources:

| Service | How to use |
|---------|------------|
| **AirNow** (U.S. EPA) | Visit https://www.airnow.gov/, enter “Los Angeles” or your ZIP code, and view the AQI (Air Quality Index) and pollutant breakdown. |
| **OpenWeatherMap Air Pollution API** | If you have an API key, call `https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/air_pollution?lat=34.0522&lon=-118.2437&appid=YOUR_KEY` to get PM2.5, PM10, O₃, NO₂, CO, SO₂ levels and the overall AQI. |
| **BreezoMeter** | Go to https://www.breezometer.com/, enter the city, and see real‑time AQI, pollutant concentrations, and health recommendations. |
| **Local news or weather apps** | Many local news stations and weather apps (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather) display live AQI values for major cities. |

If you’d like a quick snapshot right now, you can also use a search engine query like “Los Angeles air quality” or “LA AQI” and most search engines will display the current AQI directly in the results.
